issues.description: Aufgabe 01 in the problem statement asks for ID, Name, Art and URL of all Freibäder (outdoor pools). The reference solution (solution_repository/aufgabe01.sql) filters WHERE art='Hallenbad' (indoor pools), which contradicts the task and will confuse students about the intended filter. The template (template_repository/aufgabe01.sql) uses a neutral SELECT * FROM Schwimmbad and does not introduce this contradiction, so the incorrect filter is only present in the solution repository.
issues.suggested_fix: Correct the reference solution to match the problem statement by using the appropriate filter for Freibäder. For example, change the WHERE clause to WHERE art='Freibad' (or remove/adjust the WHERE clause to select Freibäder as described). Update solution_repository/aufgabe01.sql to SELECT id, name, art, url FROM Schwimmbad WHERE art='Freibad'.
